question: Does the NLEX-C5 Segment 8.2 environmental impact statement provide usable Tullahan River fish records, or only aquatic-environment context?

method.summary: Reviewed official EMB-indexed excerpts from the EIS and its public-hearing report. Direct retrieval of the official EIS PDF returned HTTP 403, so this is a bounded discovery review, not a full-document review. No access control was bypassed and no local report copy was retained.
method.reviewedContent: The indexed EIS excerpt identifies two Tullahan River surface-water-quality stations and cites Dela Paz et al. (2018) for freshwater microcrustacean context. The indexed public-hearing excerpt describes the same project water-quality stations. Exact station coordinates and analytical values were not transcribed because the primary report could not be directly retrieved.
method.coverageLimit: Only official search-indexed excerpts were accessible. The full EIS may contain other material not reviewed here; this review does not claim the report contains no fish discussion.

findings.waterbodyContext: The reviewed excerpts place two environmental water-quality stations along Tullahan River and relate that river reach to the Navotas-Malabon-Tullahan-Tenejeros system. These are project-era water-quality stations, not fish-collection stations or verified river geometry.
findings.freshwaterEcologyContext: The excerpt's cited Dela Paz et al. (2018) study is already registered as a freshwater microcrustacean inventory with no fish data. Do not double-count its invertebrate taxa as fish evidence or treat the EIS citation as an independent fish survey.
findings.fishEvidence: No fish-specific sampling method, fish taxon, or fish observation was verified in the accessible excerpts. The full report was not reviewed, so no report-wide absence conclusion is made.
findings.coordinateHandling: The indexed text indicates that Table 2.23 contains station coordinates, but they were not copied into the repository. A successful primary-document review and datum check would be required before any research-coordinate transcription; they must never be used as fish locations.

rights.reuseDecision: Retain citation and a brief internal scope note only. Do not reproduce EIS prose, tables, figures, maps, coordinates, or water-quality measurements in a public product without successful retrieval and a separate rights review.
rights.rawHandling: Official EMB search-indexed excerpts were reviewed online. Direct EIS PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403; no local copy or image was saved.

decision.disposition: Keep as a research-only Tullahan water-quality/source-discovery lead. It adds no verified fish evidence, species assertion, or app content.

nextActions: If this source becomes necessary, retrieve the complete EIS through an accessible official route before transcribing its tables or evaluating any fish-related sections.
Continue the NCR freshwater search for dated fish studies with explicit sampling methods, site-resolved taxa, and voucher or accession evidence.
Keep water-quality, microcrustacean, and fish evidence in separate lanes; do not infer present fish absence, water safety, fishing access, legal rules, or river-channel boundaries from this EIS.

sources.supports: Official EMB-indexed EIS excerpts for project water-quality stations and cited freshwater ecology context; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403.
